claims.quote: Eleven petitions were read; eleven names received the provisional stamp... The clerk wrote the lines: 'Civic pledge honoured; Pending Release column updated; eleven petitions provisionally approved; municipal notification requested.'
claims.value: Eleven petitions provisionally approved under Pending Release; civic pledge recorded and municipal notification requested

claims.quote: Rue signed her name—the same script that once marked her sold provenance—beneath the new civic column. The pen felt colder this time; it felt like choice.
claims.value: Rue signed as guarantor and her pledged instructional hours were recorded and began to be drawn down

claims.quote: "We will convene counsel within three days to consider petitions under this entry," she said. "Let the clerks prepare the lists."
claims.value: Headmistress convened counsel within three days; clerks to prepare lists and witnesses

claims.quote: The rota boards were adjusted: apprenticeship hours redistributed, rota columns narrowed, ration tickets adjusted. The cost was literal—less time at the bench for many, more labor for others.
claims.value: Aftermath includes reduced apprenticeship hours, reworked rotas, rationing, and increased labor demands

claims.quote: The Amber Bell, used for more than ceremonies now, was rung once—low, an acoustic stitch of decision—and the sound spread like a ledger being closed on one page and opened on another.
claims.value: Amber Bell rung to mark provisional approvals and departures recorded
